entities.name: PMID:37535665
observations: 2024 review of emerging IHC stains in bone and soft-tissue pathology; notes limitations and the need to correlate stains with morphology and clinical findings.

entities.name: PMID:39707804
observations: 2024 ICSH guideline review of 49 studies and 23 recommendations; bone marrow CD34 IHC protocols and readouts vary widely, so validation and standardized terminology/reporting are recommended.

entities.name: BM CD34 IHC variation
observations: ICSH guideline authors report wide variation in bone-marrow CD34 IHC protocols and readouts; interpretation should be assay-purpose- and sample-quality-specific, with validation and standardized reporting for reproducibility.

entities.name: Bone tumor IHC limits
observations: Review states bone and soft-tissue tumor IHC has diagnostic utility but limitations; morphologic and clinical correlation remains essential.
